196	  /** Catch one session's fold up to the current durable tail. */
197	  private _sync(session: Session): ReplayState {
198	    let state = this.states.get(session)
199	    if (state === undefined) {
200	      state = {
201	        consumedEvents: 0,
202	        header: undefined,
203	        surface: [],
204	        stepStart: undefined,
205	        anchor: undefined,
206	      }
207	      this.states.set(session, state)
208	    }
209	
210	    while (state.consumedEvents < session.events.length) {
211	      // oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-non-null-assertion -- contiguous session seqs index the durable log
212	      const event = session.events[state.consumedEvents]!
213	      this._foldEvent(session, state, event)
214	      state.consumedEvents += 1
